bosses.name: Razorgore the Untamed
bosses.general: Phase 1: one player controls Razorgore with the orb and breaks all 30 eggs while the raid holds the orcs and dragonkin. Phase 2: kill Razorgore (Conflagration, Fireball Volley).
bosses.tank: Hold the adds in the corners in phase 1; take Razorgore in phase 2.
bosses.healer: Protect the orb controller; heal the volleys in phase 2.
bosses.dps: Kill adds before they reach the orb; then Razorgore.

bosses.name: Vaelastrasz the Corrupt
bosses.general: Burning Adrenaline on a mana user (and the tank in turn): they run away from the raid before it kills them. Essence of the Red gives everyone mana, energy and rage. Flame Breath in front.
bosses.tank: Tanks rotate: the next one taunts when the current tank gets Adrenaline. Face him away.
bosses.healer: Heal freely, your mana refills; heal the tanks hard.
bosses.dps: Burn hard but watch threat; run out with Adrenaline. Never in front.

bosses.name: Broodlord Lashlayer
bosses.general: After the suppression room: Mortal Strike, Blast Wave, Knock Away.
bosses.tank: Back to a wall; two tanks so a knock away doesn't lose him.
bosses.healer: Heal ahead of the mortal strikes.
bosses.dps: From behind; watch threat after a knock away.

bosses.name: Firemaw
bosses.general: Flame Buffet stacks on everyone in line of sight; hide behind the pillar to drop stacks. Wing Buffet, Shadow Flame.
bosses.tank: Tanks swap when stacks get high; Onyxia Scale Cloak for Shadow Flame.
bosses.healer: Duck out of sight to drop stacks between heals.
bosses.dps: Ranged step behind the pillar now and then to drop stacks.

bosses.name: Ebonroc
bosses.general: Shadow of Ebonroc on the tank heals him when he hits: another tank taunts at once. Wing Buffet, Shadow Flame.
bosses.tank: Second tank taunts as soon as the first gets Shadow of Ebonroc.
bosses.dps: From behind; watch threat during tank swaps.

bosses.name: Flamegor
bosses.general: Frenzy: hunters Tranquilizing Shot it at once. Fire Nova grows each frenzy, Wing Buffet, Shadow Flame.
bosses.tank: Two tanks for the wing buffets.
bosses.healer: Raid-wide fire damage grows if frenzies aren't removed.
bosses.dps: Hunters: Tranq Shot on every frenzy.

bosses.name: Chromaggus
bosses.general: Two breaths from five (Time Lapse, Corrosive Acid, Incinerate, Frost Burn, Ignite Flesh): hide behind the door corner when he breathes. Brood Afflictions of five colours; Frenzy.
bosses.tank: Tank him where the raid can hide from the breaths.
bosses.healer: Hourglass Sand cures bronze; cure what you can, all five colours turn a player.
bosses.dps: Hunters Tranq the frenzy; everyone out of line of sight on breaths.

bosses.name: Lord Victor Nefarius
bosses.general: Phase 1: drakonids by colour flood both sides; kill 42 of them. Nefarius blinks, Shadow Bolts and fears.
bosses.tank: Tanks on each side gather the drakonids.

bosses.name: Nefarian
bosses.general: Lands after 42 drakonids: Shadow Flame in front, Bellowing Roar fears, Veil of Shadow; class calls punish each class. At 20% the dead drakonids rise as bone constructs.
bosses.tank: Face him away from the raid, Fear Ward and Onyxia Scale Cloak.
bosses.healer: Decurse Veil of Shadow on the tank; react to the class calls.
bosses.dps: Never in front; at 20% kill or area the bone constructs.
